svg.text: 100-bay heavy vehicle park with driver amenities
Great North Road (T2), Mkushi, Central Province
1. Do not scale. Use figured dimensions only.
2. Site plan dims in metres; building dims in mm.
3. Levels in metres, relative to site datum
4. Boundary and road reserve assumed from
aerial imagery. Confirm by cadastral survey
5. Land south of original 1.0 ha plot (0.80 ha)
to be secured before any further design.
6. Read with structural, civil, M&E and
Design vehicles DV-1 artic 18.5 m / DV-2 interlink 22.0 m
Re-planned: 101 bays on 1.80 ha; full set
ENLARGEMENT 1 — GATE, THROAT & NORTH CROSS ROAD (1:250)
Geometry: SADC vehicle dimension limits — artic 18.5 m, interlink
22.0 m, width 2.6 m. Front-axle centreline radius ≥ 11.0 m
(tractrix) model, 0.1 m steps; envelope = union of body
T1 Interlink 22 m: T2 (westbound) → gate → north cross road → Aisle 2
T2 Artic 18.5 m: Aisle 2 → south cross road → Aisle 1 → exit, left onto T2
T3 Artic 18.5 m: exit, right turn across T2 (eastbound)
T4 Interlink 22 m: drive-out from bay C08 into Aisle 2
T5 Artic 18.5 m: drive-out from bay A12 into Aisle 1
T6 Artic 18.5 m: drive-out from bay B10 into Aisle 1
T7 Artic 18.5 m: drive-out from bay D08 into south cross road
Pass criteria: ≥ 0.50 m clear of any parked vehicle (all other bays assumed occupied), no over-run of kerbs or gatehouse island.
Off-pavement area includes over-run of the bellmouth kerb returns within the RDA reserve (T1/T3 — kerb radii to be finalised in RDA
Reverse-in manoeuvres are the inverse of the drive-out paths shown (T4–T7) and are accommodated within the same aisle widths; confirm with
ENLARGEMENT 2 — BAY DRIVE-OUT, ROWS A / B / C (1:250)

g.text: T2 ROAD RESERVE (RDA) — width assumed ±20 m from centreline; verify

svg.text: 1. Bay width 4.0 m gives 1.4 m between parked vehicles (2.6 m wide) — driver's door access and safe walk-out.
2. Aisle 1 (17.5 m) serves artic rows A and B; Aisle 2 (19.0 m) serves interlink row C; south cross road (17.5 m) serves row D.
3. One-way clockwise circulation removes head-on conflict; all turns made at R ≥ 12 m on through routes.
4. Entry throat: 6.5 m inbound lane accommodates the T1 interlink swept path without striking the gatehouse island.

5. Bellmouth (R20 entry return, 1:1.5 tapered exit flare) and 10 m² concrete overrun apron at the gate junction; geometry indicative — RDA junction design to include tapers and any right-turn lane on T2.
6. Canopy columns set ≥ 0.9 m clear of the lane edge and protected by 168 mm Ø concrete-filled bollards.
